tools.name: manage_ui
tools.description: Create, refine, inspect and verify editable Roblox in-game UI. Read `weppy://ui-studio/guide` for the self-contained workflow and supported evidence; `weppy://ui-studio/tokens` offers optional visual examples and `weppy://ui-studio/functional-rules` defines advisory checks and official platform guidance. Distinguish first creation, quality improvement, narrow editing and review-only, then choose presentation independently from screen job. Compose around player decisions: meaningful values, objects, states and actions should lead the hierarchy. A missing game concept does not select an app skin or a default genre. In improvement, preserve behavior/data and explicit layout choices, but allow justified changes to size and allocation rather than adding a skin to a faulty hierarchy. Use native UI for editable content and simple surfaces; reuse reviewed parts or generate authorized parts where useful, checking actual small-size readability, alpha boundaries and crop/slice assembly. These are design recommendations, not style quotas or new prerequisites. `design_brief` optionally inspects Studio context and returns candidate brief patches; create_tree/update may omit briefId. Do not dump enum lists or require every brief field. An explicitly supplied empty, unknown, expired or unreadable briefId fails before mutation: resolve it or explicitly omit it instead of silently discarding it. Keep accepted brief_id, design_contract and advisory Layout Plan context through related calls; explicit user/projectContext evidence wins. Existing-UI review cannot infer runtime absence from empty StarterGui: follow runtime_review_required with a structured Play Client PlayerGui snapshot and saved runtimeEvidenceRef. Saved Designs are Place-scoped appearance evidence, not complete screens or verified readiness. Optional editGuard protects property-only identity/value expectations; inspect actual edit_outcome and changed_properties. agentCapabilities declares provider-neutral image generation capability, review and local output, not authorization. Always present an early asset recommendation for new UI or visual improvement, including the role, reason and source or production route. Let the user decide whether to apply it, honor an existing choice or delegation, and use the available evidence even if there are no candidates or no brief. Proceed within existing authorization. manage_assets.search requires approved intent. External screenshot search, concept/part generation and Roblox upload follow their actual user-authorized scopes; reuse granted permission and keep a supported assetless fallback. Preview and calling-agent visualReview (`recompose`, `refine`, `approved`) are optional. Mutation success, visual judgment, functional_safe and readiness are distinct; disclose skipped coverage, with responsive evidence required only when responsive_requirement says required. Keep observed platform_ui, official platform_guidance and AI interpretation separate. Review-only does not authorize mutation; findings do not authorize overriding user placement or disabling camera/default controls. Modal focus does not authorize pausing the simulation. Missing platform geometry remains unavailable; rectangle overlap alone does not prove blocked input. priority_high is reserved for observed functional visual failures; style-only findings stay medium/low.

action.description: UI action. [PRO]: design_brief, create_tree, update, delete, preview, check, design_list, design_get, design_save, design_delete. Saved designs store reusable appearance evidence for the selected Place, not complete screens or verified readiness.

designId.description: Saved design ID in this Place. Required by design_get/design_delete; optional by design_save for an explicit revision update.

expectedRevision.description: Positive expected current revision. Required for updating/deleting an existing saved design; optional for design_get. Older revisions are not archived for retrieval.

saveRequestId.description: Stable unique request ID for one design_save intent. Reuse only when retrying the same content; do not generate a new ID for an uncertain retry.

designRef.description: Optional saved appearance reference for design_brief. Reads this exact current revision without saving; explicit projectContext fields override it. Preserve the returned materialized saved_design for this task.

design.description: Reusable appearance evidence to save only when the user requests remembering a design or updating the shared design. Do not copy screen_job, primary_action, exact layout, required_states, readiness or critic verdict. Current UI and historical screenshot sources must remain distinct; label inferred/missing fields.

editGuard.description: Optional properties-only update guard. Read current target identity and values first. expectedProperties must include every changed property and each explicitly preserved property. Rejects stale identity/values, Name/Parent/Source and structural changes. Reports actual residual changed_properties and edit_outcome; does not guarantee whole-request or script-side-effect rollback.

tree.description:
Declarative UI tree JSON. The root must be ScreenGui.
Schema: {className: string, name?: string, parent?: string, properties?: {...}, layoutMetadata?: {...}, viewportPreview?: {sourcePath: string, minAspectRatio?: number}, children?: Tree[]}
Omit parent to use StarterGui. className is limited to supported Roblox GUI classes: .

In Edit mode, use ViewportFrame below a ScreenGui in StarterGui. Its viewportPreview clones one existing static Model or supported BasePart from Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, or ServerStorage. Omit viewportPreview for an empty frame. minAspectRatio is the narrowest planned width/height (default 1, range 0.25–4). UI Studio owns the camera and world; declare only UI decorations or constraints as ViewportFrame children.

Default in-game structure for HUD, button, toast, card, and most menu surfaces:
ScreenGui > Frame(BackgroundTransparency=1) > visible UI elements. Reserve a direct full-screen opaque Frame under ScreenGui for modal presentation.

layoutMetadata is optional semantic evidence. When surfaceRole / placementBand / surfaceMode / decisionSource are provided, the plugin preserves them as WeppySurfaceRole / WeppyPlacementBand / WeppySurfaceMode / WeppyDecisionSource attributes.
Existing allowed values: surfaceRole uses the neutral roles listed in weppy://ui-studio/guide; placementBand is top_left | top_right | top_center | side_left | side_right | bottom_center | lower_center | edge_contextual | center | target_relative | custom; surfaceMode is transparent_group | individual_chrome | bounded_group | shared_surface | backdrop; decisionSource is explicit_user | project_evidence | existing_ui | weppy_fallback.
Omit optional metadata when its value is unknown instead of inventing enum names. placementBand=custom describes a project-specific placement; metadata does not set Position or force a layout.

Property value encoding:
Use {xScale, xOffset, yScale, yOffset} for UDim2, {scale, offset} for UDim, {r, g, b} for Color3, {x,y}/{x,y,z} for Vector2/Vector3, and the item name string for Enum values.

targetPath.description: Path to existing UI instance. Both `StarterGui.MyGui` and `game.StarterGui.MyGui` are accepted. Used by: update, delete (required).

changes.description:
Partial update specification: {properties?: {...}, addChildren?: Tree[], removeChildren?: [string], viewportPreview?: {...}}
properties contains key/value pairs compatible with Instance property assignment. Values follow the Property value encoding documented by tree. For a managed ViewportFrame, set or clear viewportPreview separately from the other update fields.

viewportPreview.description: Edit-mode operation on a managed ViewportFrame. Supply either sourcePath with optional minAspectRatio or clear: true. Pass viewportPreview as the only field in changes.

sourcePath.description: Existing Model or supported static BasePart in Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, or ServerStorage.

minAspectRatio.description: Narrowest planned frame width/height. Defaults to 1.

clear.description: Set to true to remove the owned scene and leave the ViewportFrame empty.

visualReview.description: Optional provider-neutral visual review written by the calling agent after it inspects one saved manage_ui.preview screenshot. Findings are advisory only and never block UI changes. Used by: check.

snapshotId.description: Exact saved manage_ui.preview snapshot_id reviewed by the calling agent.

verdict.description: Primary visual critic verdict for the reviewed snapshot.

summary.description: Non-empty critic rationale grounded in the reviewed snapshot and reference evidence.

findings.description: Zero or more visual findings. An empty array requires verdict=approved, a non-empty summary, and representative context evidence.

path.description: Visible GUI path from the reviewed snapshot metadata.

reviewContext.description: Declares whether the reviewed snapshot covered interaction states and representative gameplay context. Omitting reviewContext treats both contexts as not reviewed.

tools.name: manage_camera
tools.description: Camera operations: get info, focus on instance/position, suggest view, capture Edit-mode viewport screenshot (Edit mode only; not usable during playtest).

action.description: Camera action. info: get current camera position, rotation, FOV, viewport size. focus_path: move camera to focus on instance by path. focus_position: move camera to focus on world position. suggest: get suggested camera view for a target. [PRO] screenshot: **EDIT MODE ONLY — DO NOT call while a playtest is active.** Captures the current Studio Edit-mode viewport as a PNG image (returns MCP image content). If you are uncertain whether a playtest is running, call manage_studio.play_status first and only proceed when state == "edit"; otherwise the call returns an error. Requires Studio Mesh/Image capability. In Studio, open File → Experience Settings → Security and enable "Allow Mesh / Image APIs". Resolution capped by plugin setting screenshotMaxDimension (default 1024px on longest side; kept at full resolution by Claude while reducing token cost ~40% vs 1280). Play-mode capture is not supported in v1 because Roblox platform blocks converting CaptureService temporary contentId into EditableImage from any non-edit-DM context.

path.description: Instance path to focus on. Used by: focus_path (if not provided, focuses on selection), suggest (if not provided, uses selection).

tools.name: manage_settings
tools.description: WEPPY settings management. Read or change whether Dashboard opens automatically when the MCP Server starts.

action.description: Settings action. get_dashboard_auto_open: read the saved Dashboard auto-open preference. set_dashboard_auto_open: enable or disable Dashboard auto-open from the next MCP Server start.

enabled.description: Whether Dashboard should open automatically when WEPPY MCP Server starts. Used by: set_dashboard_auto_open.

tools.name: manage_community
tools.description: WEPPY community account, posts, comments and requested play participation.

action.description: Community action. For issues, infer request type and area from the existing conversation and observed errors; ask only when unclear. Review contents before upload and require an explicit publication request before posting. Write and Play actions require an explicit user request; check current cost and revision before publishing. For a game introduction, identify the game from the conversation and available selected Studio context first. Ask about Roblox publication status and its URL only when the target or public link cannot be confirmed; obtain user confirmation before any Roblox publication.

provider.description: Optional compatibility hint. Omit for login_start so the user chooses Google or Roblox on the WEPPY website.

gameUrl.description: Public Roblox /games/{PlaceId} URL, inferred from known conversation or read-only Studio context when possible. Ask the user only if the target or public link cannot be confirmed. A positive PlaceId alone does not prove public access.

expectedEvent.description: Event ID and revision from the current quote. Omit when the quote has no event; the server receives explicit null.

attachmentId.description: Issue attachment ID returned by attachment_upload.

attachmentIds.description: Reviewed issue attachment IDs. Omit to preserve existing links; [] removes links. Feedback posts only.

support.description: Reviewed issue fields matching category: bug uses steps/expected/actual; feature problem/desired; question install_method/blocked_step/attempted. Never guess unknown environment.

clearSupport.description: Explicitly remove structured issue metadata. Feedback only; cannot combine with support. Omit to preserve metadata.

openBrowser.description: For login_start only: open the verified sign-in URL in the default browser (default true). Set false for manual or headless use.

tools.name: system_info
tools.description: System info: ping, connection status, usage tier, and read-only Studio preflight diagnostics. [PRO] place info and services list.

action.description: System action. Basic: ping (test connection, returns pong), connection (server/plugin connection info with session IDs), usage (current tier: basic/pro), preflight (structured Studio readiness checks without changing Studio or DataStore state). [PRO]: place_info (place ID, name, game ID, creator), services (list all Roblox services).

message.description: Optional message to echo back. Used by: ping.

placeId.description: Optional Studio target selector. When multiple Studio clients are connected, route this call to the active client for this Roblox placeId. If no matching active client exists, the call fails instead of falling back to another Place.

clientId.description: Optional Studio target selector. Routes this call to the exact connected WEPPY Plugin client. Takes precedence over targetAlias and placeId.

targetAlias.description: Optional Studio target selector. Routes this call to the connected WEPPY Studio target alias shown in Dashboard/Plugin, such as studio-1. Takes precedence over placeId.

tools.name: manage_studio
tools.description: Prepare Playtest values on Basic, and control Roblox Studio playtest lifecycle, automated test runs, runtime values, and editor view/rendering QA workflows on Pro.

action.description: Studio editor action. [BASIC]: playtest_prepare (read Place-scoped readiness, profiles, and last verified catalog), playtest_binding_candidates (read actual Edit selection or Play runtime value candidates), playtest_profile_save (create, update, delete, or copy a local Playtest value profile). [PRO]: playtest_adapter_plan/apply (review and apply owned Test Adapter source), playtest_action_execute (run one validated profile Action), toggle_ui_preview, test_profile_get/set/reset, experience_language_get/set, play_start/stop/pause/resume/status, test_session_start/status/stop, playtest_control_get/apply/reset, run_test.

contextId.description: Optional execution context identifier. Used to continue an existing context for mutating actions.

contextSummary.description: Optional structured execution context attached to this tool call.

replayMetadata.description: Optional replay-ready metadata attached to this tool call.

enabled.description:
Boolean value to set. Omit to toggle the current value.
Used by: toggle_ui_preview (optional).

mode.description: Playtest mode. "play" = Play mode (F5, default), "run" = Run mode (F8). Used by: play_start, run_test.

script.description: Luau test body for the explicit legacy opt-in executionKind="raw_luau" path. It is injected into ServerScriptService.__MCP_TestRunner. Used by: run_test only.

test_name.description: Optional report display name for the automated playtest run. Used by: run_test.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the automated playtest run. Default: 60. Maximum: 300. Used by: run_test.

testProfile.description: Optional Player Emulator test profile patch. Used by: test_profile_set, play_start, test_session_start, run_test.

restoreAfterTest.description: Restore the profile snapshot after the play session or automated test finishes. Defaults to true when testProfile is provided. Used by: play_start, test_session_start, run_test.

scenario.description: Structured protocol v1 scenario. Mode defaults to play and clients defaults to one. Used by: test_session_start.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key scoped to the pinned Studio target and normalized scenario. Used by: test_session_start.

sessionId.description: Structured test session identifier returned by test_session_start. Used by: test_session_status, test_session_stop.

controlProfileId.description: Place-scoped Playtest Control Profile ID. Used by: play_start, test_session_start, playtest_prepare, playtest_profile_save, playtest_control_get.

controlProfile.description: Validated local Playtest value profile draft. New v3 controls use applyOnStart=false without a placeholder value until the user explicitly saves one. Used by: playtest_profile_save.

profileOperation.description: Local profile operation. create/update use controlProfile, delete uses controlProfileId, and copy uses source/destination fields. Used by: playtest_profile_save. Conditional requirements: "create" requires `controlProfile`; "update" requires `controlProfile`, `expectedRevision`; "delete" requires `controlProfileId`, `expectedRevision`; "copy" requires `sourceProfileId`, `sourceRevision`, `destinationProfileId`, `destinationProfileName`.

sourceProfileId.description: Source profile ID for an explicit copy. Used by: playtest_profile_save.

sourceRevision.description: Expected source profile revision for an explicit copy. Used by: playtest_profile_save.

sourcePlaceId.description: Published source Place ID for an explicit profile copy. Used by: playtest_profile_save.

sourcePlaceName.description: Unpublished source Place name in the current project for an explicit profile copy. Used by: playtest_profile_save.

destinationProfileId.description: New destination profile ID for an explicit copy. Used by: playtest_profile_save.

destinationProfileName.description: New destination profile name for an explicit copy. Used by: playtest_profile_save.

candidateSource.description: Read candidates from the current Edit selection or a bounded Play runtime path. Used by: playtest_binding_candidates.

candidateTarget.description: Server or client runtime role for a Play-only candidate query. Used by: playtest_binding_candidates.

candidatePath.description: Bounded Play runtime path to inspect. Used by: playtest_binding_candidates.

maxResults.description: Maximum candidate fields to return. Used by: playtest_binding_candidates.

adapterOperation.description: Reviewed managed adapter operation. Used by: playtest_adapter_plan.

adapterId.description: Stable managed Test Adapter ID and ModuleScript name. Used by: playtest_adapter_plan.

adapterRegistrationId.description: Stable Dashboard entry ID. Used by create, update, and remove_entry adapter plans.

adapterRegistrationLabel.description: User-facing adapter value label. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterRegistrationGroup.description: Dashboard group for the adapter value. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterRegistrationKind.description: Observation or reversible control intent. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterValueType.description: JSON-compatible adapter value type. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterModulePath.description: Existing server-visible ModuleScript that owns the internal value. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterReadMethod.description: Existing module getter name. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterWriteMethod.description: Existing module setter name for a reversible control. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterMethodStyle.description: Explicit dot or colon calling convention for the existing module API. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterStudioOnly.description: Keep the managed Test Adapter unavailable outside Roblox Studio. Defaults to true and may be false only when the user explicitly asks to omit the RunService:IsStudio() check. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterConstraints.description: Optional numeric editor constraints. Used by create and update adapter plans.

adapterEnumValues.description: Allowed enum values. Used by create and update adapter plans.

productionExclusionStrategy.description: Optional artifact-hygiene strategy for excluding the adapter source even when studioOnly protection is enabled. Used by: playtest_adapter_plan.

productionExclusionReference.description: Optional production project file or configured test Place reference for the exclusion strategy. Used by: playtest_adapter_plan.

planToken.description: Unexpired reviewed adapter plan token. Used by: playtest_adapter_apply.

expectedSourceHash.description: Reviewed current source SHA-256 or absent sentinel. Used by: playtest_adapter_apply.

leaseId.description: Active runtime control lease ID. Used by: playtest_control_get, playtest_control_apply, playtest_control_reset.

expectedRevision.description: Optimistic revision. For playtest_profile_save update/delete, pass the current stored profile revision. For playtest_control_apply, pass the active runtime lease revision.

controlValues.description: Binding ID to JSON-compatible requested value. Used by: playtest_control_apply.

actionId.description: Stable Action ID from the active Playtest profile. Used by: playtest_action_execute.

actionArguments.description: Complete JSON-compatible arguments for this execution, including values from fixed Profile inputs. The Test Agent validates the actual method schema without injecting Profile defaults or comparing fixed values. Used by: playtest_action_execute.

expectedProfileRevision.description: Expected stored profile revision. Used by: playtest_action_execute.

requestId.description: Semantic idempotency identity for one Action click. Reusing it with the same input returns the same result; different input is rejected. Used by: playtest_action_execute.

stepCursor.description: Optional opaque cursor returned by a previous status page. Used by: test_session_status.

stepLimit.description: Maximum step evidence entries in one status page. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 50. Used by: test_session_status.

locale.description: Normalized locale identifier requested for the active Experience Language. Used by: experience_language_set.

placeId.description: Optional Studio target selector. When multiple Studio clients are connected, route this call to the active client for this Roblox placeId. If no matching active client exists, the call fails instead of falling back to another Place.

clientId.description: Optional Studio target selector. Routes this call to the exact connected WEPPY Plugin client. Takes precedence over targetAlias and placeId.

targetAlias.description: Optional Studio target selector. Routes this call to the connected WEPPY Studio target alias shown in Dashboard/Plugin, such as studio-1. Takes precedence over placeId.

tools.name: batch_execute
tools.description: [PRO] Execute multiple commands in a single batch. Each command is an object with "tool" name and "args". Commands execute sequentially; optionally continue on error.

commands.description: Array of commands to execute sequentially. Each command specifies a tool name and its arguments.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the tool, including action and other parameters.

stopOnError.description: If true, stop executing remaining commands when one fails. Default: true.

placeId.description: Optional Studio target selector for the entire batch. Per-item selectors inside commands[].args are rejected.

clientId.description: Optional Studio target selector for the entire batch. Takes precedence over targetAlias and placeId.

targetAlias.description: Optional Studio target selector. Routes this call to the connected WEPPY Studio target alias shown in Dashboard/Plugin, such as studio-1. Takes precedence over placeId.

tools.name: execute_luau
tools.description: [PRO] Execute arbitrary Luau code in Roblox Studio sandbox. Blocked services: HttpService, DataStoreService, MessagingService. Cannot access CoreGui/CorePackages.

contextId.description: Optional execution context identifier. Used to continue an existing context for mutating actions.

contextSummary.description: Optional structured execution context attached to this tool call.

replayMetadata.description: Optional replay-ready metadata attached to this tool call.

source.description: Luau source code to execute. The code runs in a sandboxed environment with access to game services (except blocked ones). Return values are serialized and sent back as the tool result.

placeId.description: Optional Studio target selector. When multiple Studio clients are connected, route this Luau execution to the active client for this Roblox placeId. If no matching active client exists, the call fails instead of falling back to another Place.

clientId.description: Optional Studio target selector. Routes this call to the exact connected WEPPY Plugin client. Takes precedence over targetAlias and placeId.

targetAlias.description: Optional Studio target selector. Routes this call to the connected WEPPY Studio target alias shown in Dashboard/Plugin, such as studio-1. Takes precedence over placeId.

instructions: Roblox MCP. UI 작업은 manage_ui 도구를 활용. design_brief와 시각 검수는 선택적 권장이며 생성·수정·결과 전달의 조건이 아님. 미확인 품질은 검증됐다고 표시하지 않음. 디자인 지침은 resource 'weppy://ui-studio/guide' 참조.
